rows.evidence: COMPLETE 2026-09-03, and the completeness guarantee is a COMPILE ERROR rather than a harness assertion - which is strictly stronger, since a harness row can be skipped and a build cannot. resource_origin (unset/geological/biological/manufactured) plus resource_origin_of(), a switch with NO default over all 49 resources, feeding a constexpr table and a static_assert that no entry survives as `unset`. RED-PROOFED: removing one case (clay) fails the build with 'every resource_type must declare a resource_origin - see resource_origin_of' across every TU, and restoring it compiles. Adding a resource without classifying it therefore cannot ship. Also: is_biological_resource / is_geological_resource are the predicates the Life pass will select on. FOSSIL AND LIVING ARE ONE CLASS deliberately - coal and timber differ in WHEN their life existed, and planetology already encodes that in which scalar it gates on (peak vs stage); a three-way enum would duplicate that distinction in a second place.

rows.requirement: The Body phase places only GEOLOGICAL deposits. Biological resources (coal, petroleum, peat, timber, agricultural_produce, fibre) are not placed there.

Removing biological deposits from the Body phase requires the Life phase to place them, and the Life phase (BL-765) needs BL-763 (landed) AND BL-764 (Lagrangian tiles, held back at difficulty 5). Doing R2 now would delete agricultural_produce, which survey_endowment reads as a region's FARM score (settlement.cpp), which drives cradle placement, region class, corporate focus and the entire food chain - and coal+petroleum, which it reads as ENERGY and which gate industrialisation. The world would generate without food. So the split must land WITH BL-765, not before it: the classification is the seam, and the move across it is BL-765's act.

rows.evidence: PARTIAL 2026-09-03. The endowment gate still works and is untouched - a body whose biosphere never reached land still has no coal, because planetology S8 still zeroes it. Encoding that per resource is the natural follow-on and is exactly what BL-765 needs to derive placement from the paleo record, so it belongs with that item.
